about: Totals observed outside the result rows (e.g. a review's run whose rows were not kept). evacplan.harness.load_recorded_observations reads this file. The leaderboard uses two kinds, both in the bar for beating B2 and only in the table of the same set and budget: method b2_vrptw raises B2's best observed total, and method best_of_baselines raises the best-of-baselines total. An observation keyed by a host class (a virtual machine's host string without its ', vm boot <id>' session) applies in the table of every session of that class; one keyed by a full host string applies to that host only. Either kind only raises a bar that the table's own rows define (B2 rows covering every instance; baseline rows on every instance), never defines one (program/DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-01). Add an entry only with a source that documents the number. Keys: set, budget_s, method, host, delivered_checked, source (required); unresolved, commit, recorded, note (optional).
